name: Web page shows
description: Any web page as a live channel you can schedule, with presets for the ones that make good television: WeatherStar 4000+ retro forecasts, the Mist Weather Media simulators (Weatherscan v1, v2 and Local, WeatherStar Jr, 4000 and XL, IntelliStar) with their own music, and a time-and-temperature clock. A 24/7 channel, or short segments between shows. Needs Chrome or Edge on this computer. Replaces the WeatherStar plugin and takes over its stations.
author: SchedularrTV
lowPowerNotice: each channel on air is a hidden browser drawing the page without a graphics chip, plus a live encode. WeatherStar 4000+ and the clock are fine one at a time; Weatherscan and the IntelliStar (large animated pictures) are heavy.

settings.label: WeatherStar address
settings.description: The WeatherStar 4000+ (International) site the WeatherStar preset shows. Leave empty for the public one, or point it at your own copy (npm start or its Docker image, e.g. http://localhost:8080/).

settings.label: Browser
settings.description: Chrome, Edge or Chromium, run hidden to draw the pages. Leave empty to find one automatically.
settings.lowPowerNote: On Raspberry Pi OS, install chromium (sudo apt install chromium); Chrome and Edge have no ARM Linux builds.

settings.label: ffmpeg
settings.description: Leave empty to use the ffmpeg set under App settings.

settings.label: Stream address
settings.description: How ErsatzTV reaches this scheduler. Leave empty unless ErsatzTV runs on another machine or in a container.

settings.label: Capture frames per second
settings.description: How often each page is captured (5 to 30). Higher is smoother for animated maps but uses more CPU; the stream's own frame rate is set under App settings → Hardware and video encoding.
settings.lowPowerNote: 5 to 10 here (8 is the default): forecasts and a clock change slowly.

settings.label: Keep a channel running after it goes off air (seconds)
settings.description: So back-to-back segments don't restart the browser each time.

settings.label: Draw animations at the capture rate
settings.description: The hidden browser moves the page's animations on only as often as it's captured, instead of redrawing 60 times a second for frames that are never used. They move at the same speed. A page of your own that pauses and resumes its animations may need this off.
